gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Correctly identifies no CRA triggers but miscounts CVEs (claims 9 unique vs actual 7). Good completeness and actionable recommendations, but some accuracy issues with CVE counts and severity distribution.

deepseek-v3.notes: Excellent CRA alignment with proper wildExploited/CISA KEV checks. Accurate CVE counts and severity labels. Comprehensive coverage with specific exploit sources. Concise format with clear priority rationale and SBOM hygiene note.

analysis: Deepseek-v3 significantly outperforms with superior accuracy in CVE counting, explicit CRA compliance methodology, and better structured actionable recommendations. Gemini-2.5-flash has good completeness but suffers from CVE count inaccuracies and less precise CRA alignment verification.
